headline: Software Engineer · Medical Imaging & Full Stack
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction and hands-on experience building software for medical imaging research. Combines Python, DICOM, image processing, and machine learning with full-stack development in TypeScript, React, C#/.NET, APIs, and databases. Works carefully around validation, testing, traceability, technical documentation, and the needs of people using the software.
internship_bullets: Built a Python pipeline for echocardiographic DICOM studies that extracts clinical measurements with OCR and image processing and exports structured research data.
Designed resumable batches, validation queues, human review tooling, ECG trace extraction, traceable outputs, and cross-platform handoff documentation.
Developed a source-video matcher using DICOM metadata and OpenCV ECC alignment, reducing one representative run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Built a paid full-stack operations platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO for a real 24-hour event.
Translated operator requirements into tested workflows, imports and exports, realtime synchronisation, network discovery, monitoring, and safe failover behaviour.
